newsitem.title: USA: Iomega expands license pact with Matsushita.
newsitem.headline: Iomega expands license pact with Matsushita.

text.p: Iomega Corp said Friday it signed an agreement with Matsushita Communication Industrial Co Ltd (MCI) of Japan granting enhanced non-exclusive rights to Zip drive technology and products.

The new Zip drive license extends agreements signed by the companies in September, 1996, in which MCI was granted a non-exclusive worldwide license to produce Zip drives and sell them under Matsushita's brand names as well as to OEMs.
The new Zip drive agreement allows MCI to make design modifications in addition to manufacturing and selling 100 megabyte Zip drives.
Iomega and MCI may also work together on Zip drive cost reduction projects. The companies said any modifications made to the Zip drive will be licensed back to Iomega.
